clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, Chef Grual prepares his signature dish at the Scarlet Raven Tavern. He asks you to hunt Duskwood wolves for meat while his herbs arrive from Stormwind City.

Darkshire sits isolated among Duskwood's creeping horrors. Trade caravans rarely come, farming has collapsed, and undead lurk nearby, yet the town still needs food. Chef Grual cooks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern, turning dangerous forest wolves into hearty skewers. Local timber and soil cannot support delicate crops, so he depends on spices brought from the capital to make the gamey meat palatable.

Grual has just received his latest shipment of Stormwind Seasoning Herbs. All he lacks is lean meat from the ferocious wolves stalking Duskwood. The delivery shows how Darkshire remains tied to the wider kingdom: royal military aid has dwindled, while small civic ties and supply lines between city merchants and outer hamlets barely endure.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite! Sure, I can make you some. But first I'll need the supplies. Bring me 10 Lean Wolf Flanks. Given the many wolves here in the forest, I am sure finding the Flanks will be no problem. Fortunately for you, I just received my recent shipment of Stormwind Seasoning Herbs, so all I need are the flanks to get started.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet? How about the herbs from Felicia in Stormwind?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very nice work, friend! Enjoy the delicacy known as Seasoned Wolf Kabob!
